facts.text: Per-tenant extension creator is responsible for licensing and subject to their own terms, conditions, and support.
Extension publisher must maintain compatibility with new Business Central releases.
Extension not compatible with new release within 90 days will be removed and tenant upgraded.
Microsoft reserves right to inspect extension code for diagnostic and troubleshooting on security or technical issues.
Microsoft may collect error messages, call stacks, object names, and method signatures during extension execution or compilation.
Microsoft may collect and share extension names, versions, and dependencies with other developers.
Collected data may be kept outside geographical boundaries and shared with partner telemetry or app insights.
